preconditions.expression: all(len(ladder) == 2 and 1 <= ladder[0] < ladder[1] <= 100 for ladder in ladders)
preconditions.description: Each ladder is a list of two integers where the start is strictly less than the end, and both are within the board range [1, 100].

preconditions.expression: all(len(snake) == 2 and 1 <= snake[0] > snake[1] >= 1 for snake in snakes)
preconditions.description: Each snake is a list of two integers where the start is strictly greater than the end, and both are within the board range [1, 100].

preconditions.expression: len(set(start for ladder in ladders for start in ladder)) + len(set(start for snake in snakes for start in snake)) <= 100
preconditions.description: No square is the start of more than one ladder or snake.

preconditions.expression: 1 not in {start for ladder in ladders for start in ladder} and 1 not in {start for snake in snakes for start in snake}
preconditions.description: Square 1 is never the start of a ladder or snake.

preconditions.expression: 100 not in {start for ladder in ladders for start in ladder} and 100 not in {start for snake in snakes for start in snake}
preconditions.description: Square 100 is never the start of a ladder or snake.

postconditions.description: The function returns -1 if no path exists, otherwise returns a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of rolls (at most 100).

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (all(1 <= current <= 100 for current in path) and path[-1] == 100)
postconditions.description: If a path exists, there exists a sequence of positions starting at 1 and ending at 100, where each step is a die roll (1-6) or a ladder/snake transition, and the total number of rolls equals return_value.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (not exists(path, rolls) where (all(1 <= current <= 100 for current in path) and path[-1] == 100 and sum(1 for _ in path[:-1]) < return_value))
postconditions.description: If a path exists, return_value is the minimum number of rolls required to reach 100 from 1, considering all possible die rolls and transitions.
